title: Acausal / Common-Cause Cooperation: LLM vs. Stated Similarity of Partner

original_idea.body:
# Acausal / Common-Cause Cooperation

One-shot PD varying partner description (human, different AI, identical copy); measure cooperation rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to multi-agent collusion but acausal-coordination relevance is speculative, leaving a gap to concrete catastrophe.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: One-shot PD with varied partner framing, inference-only; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment with cooperation-rate metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, neglected agent-foundations angle.

novelty.reasoning: LLM PD behavior is studied; the 'identical copy' acausal-framing test may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: LLM cooperation in PD is studied; the acausal identical-copy framing may be open.
